_notes: 17 pages (16 deck slides plus a bestpitchdeck.com advert page). Investor deck dated July 2022 with an unusually complete company page - founding date, HQ, headcount, customer logos and a fundraising history - but every revenue, ARR and projection figure is visibly redacted. Investors appear only in the fundraising-history slide (p15) as lead investors of rounds already closed - North-East Venture, VF Venture and Kickass Capital - while the 2022 strategic round and 2023 Series B name none; the deck dates itself 'July 2022' in the running header on every slide.

one_liner.value: A one-stop-shop for digital movement: an AI-infused, collaborative, easily accessible, vertically integrated motion platform

expected_flags.note: no readable revenue or ARR figure: the company-background charts, the ARR chart and the full 2022-2025 financial projections table are all overlaid with 'Redacted'
'Revenue growth over the last 3 years' and 'ARR growth' are shown as bar charts whose axes and values are redacted, so the growth claim has no base figure and no multiple

'Rokoko at a glance' states more than 50,000 users in 100+ countries, while the commercial flywheel slide states Rokoko Motion Library has 80,000+ registered users, with no explanation of the difference
'the world's most powerful dataset of human motion' and 'the largest fleet of mocap systems in the market' asserted with no comparison, source or competitor data
the mocap-systems-in-market and assets-created-per-year chart projects forward to 2024 (to ~80K systems and ~90M assets) with no stated assumptions or historical base beyond 2021-2022
the $3M strategic round and $80M pre-money are named in the fundraising history, but there is no use-of-proceeds, milestone plan or runway slide
